title: Happy Glass Draw
description: Sketch clever physics bridges and funnels with a single pencil stroke to channel rushing water into an empty smiling glass for three-star perfection.
controls: Press and drag to draw solid pencil lines that guide falling water smoothly into the cup up to the dotted fill line.

zh-CN.title: 欢乐水杯画线
zh-CN.description: 全球亿级下载经典物理画线欢乐水杯：用一支铅笔自由画线搭建导流槽，把清水精准引入空水杯让它开心大笑，画得越短星级越高！
zh-CN.controls: 按住屏幕自由画线搭建物理滑道，引导水流灌满下方水杯至虚线以上即可三星通关。
